archetype: Electric & Neon (Future, Speed, VR, Disruption) customized for Enterprise

headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight). Do not use Inter or generic sans. Use for Widget Titles, Page Headers, and high-impact metrics.

body.usage: Mainly for tabular data, descriptions, and standard text. Use tracking-wide for overlines/labels.

surfaces.retro_futurism: Subtle repeating-linear-gradient scanlines for terminal/log moments if any
surfaces.grid_borders: Use border-collapse layout for data tables to expose the skeleton, mimicking UE5 wireframes.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: Grid cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized. Dense, data-heavy layout.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Wide gaps between structural sections to avoid clutter.
grids_and_layouts.navigation: Left sidebar (w-64) or Top nav. Use Glassmorphism (bg-black/60, blur-2xl) if floating, or Solid Background with hard 1px border if fixed.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align forms, lists, tabular data. Optical alignment for icons inside buttons.

component_guidelines.cards: Go flat, rectangular, sharp edges or max rounded-md (8px). 1px subtle border. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), border color darkens or glows with primary accent.
component_guidelines.buttons: Sharp edges or slightly rounded. Primary button: bg-[#0066FF] text-white hover:bg-[#0066FF]/80. Include micro-interactions (scale down on click).
component_guidelines.tables: Shadcn table. Remove generic card wrapper, use grid borders. Rows should have hover:bg-white/5.
component_guidelines.status_badges: Orders Payment Status: Neon Green text + bg-green-500/10 for Paid. Neon Yellow + bg-yellow-500/10 for Pending. Uppercase, tracking-widest, text-[10px] font-bold.

motion.transitions: Use specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform) with 0.2s ease. NO universal 'all' transition.
motion.hover: Explicitly set text color on hover. Lift cards on hover.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for dashboard widgets and table rows.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA contrast. Use text-shadow over images. Focus rings must be high contrast (ring-2 ring-[#0066FF]).
accessibility.testing: All interactive/key elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='nav-summary-link').

image_urls.description: Abstract iridescent curves. Use as atmospheric background for the Login Screen or behind the Header.
Man in VR headset. Can be used for trainee profiles or group thumbnails.
Immersive VR gaming. Use as hero image on Login Screen or News Announcement card.
Abstract black/green texture. Use as overlay for metric cards or announcement background.

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for dense dashboard needs. Sharp, technical.

libraries.3d: Optional: Framer Motion 3D for simple card tilts. TSParticles for background dust/mesh on the login page to emphasize 'Cygnus Rift' spatial tech.
libraries.charts: Shadcn charts (Recharts) with neon green/blue lines against void black backgrounds, with glow filters.
libraries.ui: Shadcn UI (Tables, Tabs, Cards, Dialogs). Custom styling to strip 'Vercel look' and add high-end VR engine look.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
USE pure black backgrounds (#050505) with 1px border-white/10 to create technical grid structures.
NEVER use generic 'Inter' for headings. Install and use 'Unbounded' for headings, 'IBM Plex Sans' for body.
EVERY button, link, and interactive widget MUST have a data-testid attribute.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, navs, or modals. Always use solid dark or bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl.
IMPLEMENT a 'Tracing Beam' or subtle neon border effect on active nav items or top metric cards.
Login Screen: Split screen. Left: Abstract UE5/VR image with overlay. Right: Login form with Google / Guest access. Very minimal, pure cinematic vibe.
Dashboard layout: Left sidebar (Summary, Sessions, Groups, Orders, Profile). Main area: Grid layout. Top row: Quick Analytics. Next rows: My Schedule, Orders, Groups, News.
Orders table needs vibrant status dots (Neon Green for paid, Neon Orange for pending) and a download icon for actions.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
